title: F_7 packed type plus ops per R2 outcome
description:
Implement the F_7 packed type chosen by R2 (`f10152f6`), with the per-op formulas from the R2 decision doc and proptest cross-checks against scalar `Fp<7>`.

## Background

R2's decision doc (`dev/plans/r2_f7_encoding_decision.md`) names the winning F_7 encoding and documents the bitwise op count. The R2 outcome chose a multiplication via LUT table approach (per the prompt's hint). This issue lands the packed type at `gf2-algebra::packed::packed7` with the implementation directly transliterating the formulas from the R2 doc.

The LUT table, if used, is a `static` const initialised at compile time so no `OnceLock` is involved (per Kani-friendliness from the lessons in `feedback_jit_doc_links.md` and the verification-work conventions).

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] `gf2-algebra::packed::packed7::Packed7` exists with the encoding chosen by R2.
- [ ] [hard] `Packed7` implements `PackedField<Fp<7>>` per the D1b trait surface.
- [ ] [hard] `add`, `sub`, `mul`, `neg` use formulas (and LUT if applicable) from R2; the LUT is a `static` const, not `OnceLock`-initialised.
- [ ] [hard] Proptest cross-checks all four ops against scalar `Fp<7>` per-lane on 1000 random pairs.
- [ ] [hard] `Packed7Vec` companion exists with `mask_tail` invariant; word-boundary tests on the same set as Packed5Vec.
- [ ] [hard] `cargo nextest run -p gf2-algebra --release --profile ci` passes.
